name: GitHub
summary: GitHub's official MCP server: work with repos, issues, pull requests, Actions and code security from your agent.
description: The GitHub MCP Server connects AI tools directly to GitHub's platform, letting agents read repositories and code files, manage issues and pull requests, analyze code, and automate workflows. It is available as a remote server hosted by GitHub or as a local server run via Docker.
tools: Toolsets: pull_requests, code_security, secret_protection, security_advisories, copilot_spaces

setup.label: Local via Docker in Claude Code
setup.code: claude mcp add github -e GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN=$GITHUB_PAT -- docker run -i --rm -e GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN ghcr.io/github/github-mcp-server

prompts: Summarize the open pull requests in my repo that are waiting on review.
Find where the auth middleware is defined in this repository and explain it.
Create an issue describing the bug we just reproduced.

auth.revokeLabel: GitHub → Settings → Applications → Authorized OAuth Apps

name: GitLab (community)
summary: Community GitLab MCP server covering merge requests, pipelines, projects and the GitLab API.
description: A widely used community-maintained MCP server for GitLab. It exposes tools for merge requests, diffs, pipelines and jobs, groups, environments and generic GitLab API requests. The original reference GitLab server from the MCP project is archived. Since v2.3.6 every GITLAB_API_URL entry must start with http:// or https://, and a comma in an embedded password must be written as %2C.

setup.label: Run with npx (README's pinned stable release)

prompts: Review the diff of merge request !42 and list risky changes.
Why did the latest pipeline on main fail?
Validate this .gitlab-ci.yml before I push it.

name: Git
summary: Reference server for reading, searching and manipulating local Git repositories.
description: One of the reference servers maintained in the official modelcontextprotocol/servers repo. It gives an LLM tools to inspect status, diffs and logs and to stage, commit, reset and branch in a local Git repository. As of the 2026.10.19 release it is built on the MCP Python SDK 2.x (mcp>=2.3,<3).
prompts: Show me what changed since the last commit and write a commit message.
List the last 10 commits touching the billing module.
Create a branch called fix/login-redirect.

name: Filesystem
summary: Reference server for secure file operations restricted to directories you allow.
description: Official reference server that lets an agent read, write, edit, move and search files, but only inside the directories passed on the command line (or provided via MCP Roots). Requires Node.js 24 or later (as of server version 2.0.0).
prompts: Find every markdown file in my notes folder that mentions 'Q3 plan'.
Rename all screenshots on my Desktop to include their date.
Show the directory tree of this project.

name: Fetch
summary: Reference server that fetches web pages and converts them to markdown for LLMs.
description: Official reference server that retrieves a URL and converts HTML to markdown, with support for reading long pages in chunks via start_index and max_length. As of the 2026.10.19 release it is built on the MCP Python SDK 2.x (mcp>=2.3,<3).
prompts: Fetch this blog post and summarize it in five bullets.
Read the changelog page and list breaking changes.

name: Memory
summary: Knowledge-graph based persistent memory for your assistant.
description: Official reference server that stores entities, relations and observations in a local knowledge graph so an assistant can remember facts across chats. Requires Node.js 24 or later (as of server version 2.0.0).
prompts: Remember that my preferred stack is Next.js + Postgres.
What do you remember about project Atlas?

name: Sequential Thinking
summary: Structured, reflective step-by-step problem solving through thought sequences.
description: Official reference server that provides a tool for breaking complex problems into revisable, branching sequences of thoughts. Requires Node.js 24 or later (as of server version 2.0.0).
prompts: Think step by step through the migration plan from MySQL to Postgres.
Break this product launch into stages and revise as needed.

name: Time
summary: Current time and timezone conversion for your agent.
description: Official reference server that returns the current time in any IANA timezone and converts times between timezones. As of the 2026.10.19 release it is built on the MCP Python SDK 2.x (mcp>=2.3,<3).
prompts: What time is it in Tokyo right now?
If it's 3pm in New York, what time is it in Berlin?

name: Everything (test server)
summary: Reference test server exercising every MCP feature: prompts, resources and tools.
description: Official server meant for MCP client builders. It implements prompts, resources, tools and other protocol features so you can test a client end to end. Requires Node.js 24 or later (as of server version 2.0.0).
tools: Sample tools, resources and prompts covering the MCP spec
prompts: List every tool and resource this server exposes.

name: Figma
summary: Figma's official MCP server brings design context (frames, variables, components) into coding agents.

prompts: Implement the selected Figma frame as a React component using our design tokens.
List the color variables used in this Figma file.

prompts: Implement this Figma frame link in Tailwind.
Download the icons from this Figma frame into /public.

name: NeverApply
summary: NeverApply's remote MCP server for searching jobs, reviewing matches, tracking applications and applying to jobs you approve.
description: NeverApply is a hosted MCP server (Streamable HTTP) that connects an assistant to your NeverApply account. Read access covers job search, matches, your profile and application history. Write access lets it update your profile, upload a resume, save answers, tailor resumes and prepare interview drafts. Apply access lets it submit applications, which NeverApply says needs credits and your explicit approval of each job. Sign-in is OAuth 2.1 with PKCE and you choose which permissions to grant; access can be revoked in Settings, Connected AI clients. Resume tailoring and interview preparation require a paid plan.
tools: Search jobs and read job details (search_jobs, get_job)
Read and update your profile, upload a resume, save answers
List and read your applications (list_applications, get_application)
Tailor resumes and prepare for interviews (paid plan)
Apply to jobs you approve (apply_to_job, answer_screening_question, approve_application)

setup.label: Claude Code
setup.code:
claude mcp add --transport http neverapply https://neverapply.co/mcp
# then run /mcp in Claude Code and sign in

setup.label: Codex
setup.code:
codex mcp add neverapply --url https://neverapply.co/mcp
codex mcp login neverapply

setup.label: Claude.ai / ChatGPT (custom connector)
setup.code:
# Add a custom connector (Claude) or custom MCP server (ChatGPT, Developer mode)
# Name: NeverApply
# Server URL: https://neverapply.co/mcp
# then sign in to NeverApply and choose permissions

prompts: Find remote product manager jobs in Germany that fit me.
What applications are waiting for me?

auth.scopes: mcp:read, mcp:write, mcp:apply (advertised in the server's OAuth metadata). Write and apply scopes allow profile changes and job applications; NeverApply says applications are only sent for jobs you explicitly approve.
